title: Crystalized Cherry Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Crystalized’s Cherry Ice combines the deep, juicy taste of ripe Cherry with a bracing icy exhale for a refreshingly balanced vape. The deep fruity sweetness of Cherry is met with a cooling breeze of Menthol, delivering a crisp and satisfying contrast. This expertly-layered blend offers a fruit and menthol pairing that remains sweet, rich, and refreshing throughout. With a versatile 50% VG / 50% PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crystalized is a UK-based e-liquid brand dedicated to crafting distinctive, flavourful vape juices with an emphasis on MTL vaping. Their 50/50 VG/PG shortfills deliver clean, bright and consistent flavours, making them an excellent choice for everyday vaping.
